title: Zakhmi Insan (dub) (dass Tamil)
desc: Antony falls in love with Rajeswari who belongs to an upper caste family. When her father kills her sister for marrying a man from the lower caste, she decides to elope with Antony.

title: C Kkompany
desc: A comedy film about three friends who start a fictitious company called C Kkompany to extort money from the corrupt people in their neighborhood. However, their plan backfires when the news of their company spreads like wildfire, and they become the talk of the town. The movie showcases the hilarious consequences of their actions and how they try to redeem themselves in front of the public.

title: Yamla Pagla Deewana
desc: Dharam (Dharmendra) and Gajodhar (Bobby Deol) are a father-son con team skilled in tricking their unsuspecting fellow Indians. When a nonresident Indian, Paramvir (Sunny Deol), arrives from Vancouver claiming to be Dharam's long-lost son, the duo doesn't buy it, but they admire his strength and take him into their fold. Eventually Gajodhar falls for a young woman, Saheba (Kulraj Randhawa). But when Saheba's brothers disapprove of the match, Paramvir designs a plan for Gajodhar to win her back.

title: Jhansi Ki Rani Lakshmibai
desc: Jhansi Ki Rani Lakshmibai tells the heroic story of Rani Lakshmibai, a fearless queen who led a valiant resistance against British rule. Defying all odds, she became a symbol of courage, sacrifice, and India's fight for freedom.

title: Sultaan
desc: Don Kabira helps Ayesha in saving her garage from local goons. However, he hides the fact that he was an honest inspector sometime ago after which Ayesha decides to find out the reason for his transformation.
